fields.name: skill_name
fields.description: The name of the Claude Code skill defined in this file (from the YAML frontmatter or filename if missing).

fields.name: has_frontmatter
fields.description: True if the file starts with a valid YAML frontmatter block (---...---).

fields.name: description_quality
fields.description: Quality of the skill description: clear (specific triggers, concrete use cases), vague (generic adjectives, no triggers), missing (no description field).

fields.name: trigger_count
fields.description: How many distinct usage triggers the description hints at (0-5+). 0 = no triggers, 5 = many specific triggers.

fields.name: has_examples
fields.description: True if the skill body includes at least one concrete usage example.

fields.name: issues
fields.description: Up to 5 issues that would prevent this skill from triggering reliably. Examples: missing triggers, unclear scope, conflicting with other skills.
